proposition: According to Melvin-Koushki, the K. al-Mafahis, completed in 823/1420, treats the letters in numerological, symbological and phonological aspects, plus a fourth section on the letters as such.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, author of K. al-Mafaḥiṣ
mediation.note: A doctrinal work, not addressed to a judge; the duress rule counts a work as evidence of what he held.
We have the work only as MK summarises or translates it; most of the lettrist works are unedited, so MK's paraphrase cannot be checked against a printed text.
